name: Sign zone
notes: The area around a menu sign (10 px on every side of it): while the monster is in it, 'spot' holds the sign's number, so its name shows over the monster's head and A or B know what to do (plr_menu); leaving it puts 'spot' back to 0. Used for the CLASSIC (1) and CLEAR SAVE (2) signs, the number set per sign in the scene; the WAVES sign has its own, trg_sign_waves. By the CLASSIC sign it also sets 'entry' to the chosen monster's classic run and 'near', so the bottom line of the screen shows that monster's classic best time; leaving clears 'near'.
